subject: MAP: deployment-mode & region alignment — evaluation timeline and close asks
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@acme.health>, Tom Baxter <tbaxter@acme.health>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: deployment-mode & region alignment — evaluation timeline and close asks

Hi Sara, Tom —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation I've sketched a Mutual Action Plan (attached) that focuses on two parallel evaluation tracks: (1) Hosted (fastest time-to-value) with a Dedicated-reserved fallback, and (2) Private (VPC / on-prem) for the regulatory path. High-level asks and timeline below — please review and confirm feasibility from your side.

Summary of asks (week by week cadence):
- Week 1 (Sept 7–13): Exchange compliance evidence (SOC2 top-line, encryption/KMS notes), share procurement timeline and PO process.
- Week 2 (Sept 14–20): Cost delta worksheet review (Dedicated vs Private) + technical scoping call for VPC connectivity.
- Week 3 (Sept 21–27): Final decision point (go-live lane selection) and DocuSign SOW prep.

Open questions for Acme:
- Data residency: do you require a US-only region or specific geofencing within the US?
- Procurement: what is your internal PO cutoff date to hit an Oct POC start?
- Private deployment constraints: do you need air-gapped/on-prem or is VPC with KMS sufficient?

Attached: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria).

Next steps from Redwood:
- We will produce a short dedicated vs private cost delta (2–3 pages) and a technical runbook for VPC connectivity by EOD Fri Sept 10.
- Laura will lead the compliance evidence packet; Priyom will scope network tasks.

If the above timeline works, please reply with any procurement constraints and we’ll lock dates.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
[note: attachment stub: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
From: Sara Li <sara.li@acme.health>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Tom Baxter <tbaxter@acme.health>
Cc: procurement@acme.health
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: deployment-mode & region alignment — evaluation timeline and close asks

Thanks Nikhil — this looks good and practicable. A few quick answers from Acme:
- We must keep data resident in the US. East and West are both acceptable, but we need a documented geofence — if you can confirm both are options that helps.
- Procurement: our PO lead says final internal approval by Sept 20 is realistic if commercial terms are agreed by Sept 17.
- Private vs VPC: clinical teams prefer VPC with customer-managed KMS if it avoids lengthy on-prem approvals. However, we need explicit guidance on what evidence Redwood will provide for audit.

I will coordinate a short scoping call for network/infra on Thur Sep 9 — Tom is looping procurement into this thread.

Sara Li
Head of IT Security — Acme Health
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Sara Li <sara.li@acme.health>, Tom Baxter <tbaxter@acme.health>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: deployment-mode & region alignment — evaluation timeline and close asks

Folks —

Quick internal note and proposed recommendation to present to Acme in the network call:
- We will provide SOC 2 type II summary (control map) and a KMS integration note (how Redwood integrates with customer-managed keys in both Dedicated and Private). I can produce a one-pager by EOD Thu Sep 10.
- Recommended default: start with Hosted + Reserved Dedicated capacity for the POC (lowest friction) and keep Private as the formal compliance path. This reduces time-to-PO and gives Acme a fall-back if governance requires a self-managed deployment later.

Action items (internal):
- Priyom: outline VPC peering steps and expected lead times. (target: Sep 10)
- Marissa: prepare a short costing deck comparing Dedicated vs Private with clear assumptions. (target: Sep 10)

I will join the Thu Sep 9 network call and walk through the evidence packet.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Product — Redwood Inference
From: Tom Baxter <tbaxter@acme.health>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Sara Li <sara.li@acme.health>
Cc: procurement@acme.health
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: deployment-mode & region alignment — evaluation timeline and close asks

Appreciate the clear map. Two asks from procurement and architecture:
1) Procurement asks that you complete and return the attached procurement template by Sept 17 so we can start internal approvals. (see Proc_Temp attached)
2) Architecture needs a point estimate for the incremental monthly cost (USD) between Dedicated reserved capacity and a Private VPC setup (include 95th percentile throughput assumptions). Can you provide that by COB Sept 14?

If Acme can see a clear cost delta and the SOC2 + KMS notes, we will aim to have approval by Sept 20.

Tom Baxter
VP of Procurement — Acme Health
[attachment stub: Procurement_Template_Acme.pdf]

Subject: Re: MAP: deployment-mode & region alignment — evaluation timeline and close asks

Thanks everyone — quick summary and owners so we have a single source of truth in the MAP: 

Redwood deliverables (owners / dates):
- Compliance packet (SOC2 summary + KMS integration note) — Laura — Sep 10 EOD. [Attachment: Dedicated_vs_Private_costing.pdf will include the SOC2 references section]
- VPC peering runbook + expected lead times — Priyom — Sep 10 EOD.
- Cost delta one-pager (monthly incremental, 95th pct assumptions) — Marissa — Sep 14 COB.
- Completed procurement template returned to Acme — Nikhil — Sep 17 (I will upload signed draft to the DocuSign link).

Acme asks / decision gates: 
- Confirm data residency geofence (Sara) — requested today; East/West US acceptable but will you confirm a preference?
- Procurement target decision: Sep 20 (internal).

Proposed MAP close path: if Acme confirms US residency and procurement returns the template by Sep 17, Redwood will prepare SOW and aim for PO execution and POC kickoff the week of Oct 5. If procurement requires private-only deployment and we need on-prem, we will run a parallel scoping sprint but expect an extended lead time (4–8 weeks).

Links: HubSpot deal (ACME-348): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-348; DocuSign SOW placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/link/ACME-348-SOW

Attachments referenced: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx, Dedicated_vs_Private_costing.pdf, Procurement_Template_Acme.pdf

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet after Laura/Marissa/Priyom drop their docs.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
